summary: Virtuix Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two routine matters. On September 29, 2026, the Board granted CFO Thomas McGinnis 100,000 restricted stock units under the 2025 Omnibus Incentive Plan, vesting 25% on the first anniversary and the remainder quarterly over four years, with forfeiture on termination or cause. Separately, the September 24, 2026 Annual Meeting, with 86,072,228 votes (78.31% of voting power) represented, approved three Class I directors and advisory ratification of EisnerAmper LLP as auditor for fiscal 2027. No transactional or special-situation event is present.
